provenance_legend.ps_text: Stated in the SIH26092 problem statement itself. Indicative only — the PS contradicts itself on interest rates (background says 6.5-8%, deliverable 2 says 6.5-15%), so treat even these as unverified.
provenance_legend.placeholder: Invented purely to make the schema concrete and the tests runnable. Has no basis. MUST be replaced.
provenance_legend.official_guideline: Transcribed from NSFDC published guideline https://nsfdc.nic.in/scheme and https://nsfdc.nic.in/eligibility-requirements on 2026-09-09. Only these may be shown publicly.

_README.how_to_use: Two team members transcribe the official guidelines into this file independently, then diff and reconcile. Flip 'verified' to true only for values you can point at in a source document. Any row still false at demo time goes in VERIFY.md and stays off the slides.
_README.schema_note: Interest rates deliberately live in 'interest_rules' as condition-keyed bands, not as a scalar, because these schemes band rates by loan size and applicant category. A single rate column would force a hardcoded inaccuracy.
_README.null_semantics: A null 'value' means UNKNOWN, not zero. The engine treats a null required parameter as NOT COMPUTABLE and reports the missing parameter path — it never substitutes a default. See src/core/finance/loan.ts.
_README.demo_overlay_note: Because almost every value here is null, the engine cannot produce figures from this file alone. data/schemes.demo-overlay.json supplies exercisable NON-AUTHORITATIVE values so tests, the personas CLI and the UI can run. Any result computed with the overlay carries figures_authoritative:false and the UI renders a permanent banner. Never merge overlay values into this file.

_CHANGELOG: 2026-08-26 — structural additions only, no provenanced value altered: (a) added 'tenure_includes_moratorium' as an explicit field because ROADMAP §8.1 lists it as an open question and it must not be an assumption; (b) added 'cost_ceiling_rules' to EDU because ROADMAP §6 flags that education schemes set separate ceilings for study in India vs abroad and one scalar ceiling would force a wrong number; (c) split the composite predicate 'CATEGORY_SC_VERIFIED' into 'CATEGORY_SC' and 'CASTE_CERT_AVAILABLE' so remediation can name a single concrete action — a composite predicate cannot yield a minimum qualifying change; (d) added 'INCOME_PROOF_AVAILABLE' for the same reason; (e) added 'min_project_cost' distinct from 'min_loan' because ROADMAP asks for the floor that separates MICRO from TERM and a cost floor and a loan floor are different things.

2026-09-09 — Phase 0 transcription from official NSFDC site https://nsfdc.nic.in/scheme (last updated 09.09.2026 fetched 2026-09-09) and https://nsfdc.nic.in/eligibility-requirements (09.09.2026). MICRO and TERM cost/loan caps, loan_pct_cap, interest beneficiary rates (MICRO 6.5%, TERM 8%, AMY 15%, UNY 13%/15%, ELS 6.5%), tenure and moratorium periods, and global income cap 5.00 lakh (effective 07.01.2026) transcribed as official_guideline. Fields not stated on those pages (margin_pct, subsidy, moratorium_interest_treatment) remain placeholder with TODO(verify) — see VERIFY.md. Added 2 new schemes: AMY (Aajeevika Micro-Finance Yojana, type MICRO) and UNY (Udyam Nidhi Yojana, type MICRO) from same source.

open_questions_for_phase_0: Which corporation sponsors this PS? Resolved as NSFDC per https://nsfdc.nic.in/scheme and https://nsfdc.nic.in/eligibility-requirements — confirm with SIH nodal officer that PS SIH26092 expects NSFDC.

Is ₹1.40 lakh / ₹50 lakh the project cost ceiling or the loan ceiling? Resolved: MICRO max_unit_cost 1.40L / max_loan 1.25L, TERM max_unit_cost 50L / max_loan 45L, UNY 5L/4.5L, ELS 40L — per https://nsfdc.nic.in/scheme, but TERM 45L vs 50L still needs compendium confirmation.

Is there a subsidy component, and is it front-ended or back-ended? No subsidy mentioned on scheme page for these 5 — likely 0, but verify compendium (Central Sector subsidy scheme referenced in compendium excerpt).

What is the actual banded rate card, and does it vary by gender or applicant category? Partially resolved: rates are per-channel (SCA 6.5-8%, NBFC-MFI 15%, Coop 13%/15%) not by gender — verify compendium for gender/category bands.

Which moratorium interest treatment applies to each scheme? Still unresolved — page states duration only, not CAPITALISED/SERVICED/WAIVED. Placeholder set to keep demo computable, but remains TODO(verify).

Is the maximum tenure inclusive or exclusive of the moratorium? Resolved for 4 schemes as inclusive (wording includes moratorium) per https://nsfdc.nic.in/scheme — EDU remains ambiguous (tenure_includes_moratorium null).
What is the loan floor that separates MICRO from TERM? Resolved as ₹1.40 lakh unit cost boundary and ₹1.25 lakh loan boundary per §1/§2.
Which partner types are actually authorised to process each scheme category? Partially resolved: MFS/TERM via SCAs/CAs, AMY via NBFC-MFI, UNY via Cooperatives/SFBs — need exact SCA list.
Does the education scheme have separate ceilings for study in India vs abroad? NSFDC page shows single ₹40 lakh for both — suggests no split, but placeholder kept for verification.
Is the education moratorium a fixed month count or course-duration-plus-grace? Resolved as course-duration-based per §5 — fixed month fields are wrong shape for EDU, left null.

Can one applicant be eligible for more than one scheme at the same time? With new purpose lists still disjoint, overlap remains unlikely — but AMY vs MICRO now overlap on micro purposes if purposes not disjoint. Review RECOMMENDATION_POLICY.
